proposed_facts.reason: The canonical declaration is a function-local static int array containing 15 and 16. State-table animation IDs establish valid lookup inputs 1 and 2 and the invalid negative index from state 0. The replacement explicitly avoids establishing compiled placement or byte layout.

Canonical helper and pickup bodies establish speed writes, state-2 entry and accessory installation. ftCommon_8007E83C independently establishes indirect dispatch at requested status 6 and the zero-duration versus scaled-duration branches.
Both pickup and shared fighter-controller uses are demonstrated. The replacement corrects pickup exclusivity without assigning an unproven opening or closing meaning to state 2.

The threshold query only returns a boolean; the fighter consumer uses it in the LandingFallSpecial retention guard. All three item states instead share the owner-dependent completion callback. The proposal and functionality document consistently distinguish these mechanisms.
